Improvements: Make bun dev run current automatically select a cache for the current Git branch and working tree, refresh changed UI/helpers, and reassemble changed native support or packaging inputs using a matching verified Electron runtime. Existing development profiles are preserved.

Use a same-graph PipeWire loopback for application-audio capture instead of the raw pw-cat-to-pacat bridge, avoiding an extra PCM FIFO while keeping capture bound to the selected private sinks. Real PulseAudio retains its separate bridge.
Fixes: Match Niri PiP top spacing to configured gaps and struts without adding the previous 16-pixel minimum at the top; preserve side and bottom margins and corner highlighting.
Return an unavailable PiP state when a pending compositor query finishes after the window closes, avoiding access to a destroyed window.
Restart managed development windows when a relaunch signal arrives while the old process is still running.

New: Choose the default PiP corner, turn automatic positioning on or off, and control whether floating PiP windows stay on top.
Move a floating PiP window between corners directly from its corner controls.
Improvements: Respect compositor work areas, monitor scaling and reserved space when placing PiP windows on Niri, Sway, Hyprland and KDE Wayland. KDE placement uses temporary KWin scripts without changing window rules.
Group dependent PiP settings under their controlling options and share the select layout with Display settings.
Run managed development versions with temporary profiles, route Discord links to the selected running profile, and count shared files once when reporting disk usage.
Check AppImage builds and launches in the main checks workflow, share project setup across workflows, and declare KDE PiP integration dependencies in Linux packages.
Fixes: Size PiP windows from the current video rather than stale geometry, distinguish letterboxing from window chrome, and bound the initial window even when video metadata is unavailable.
Preserve manual PiP resizing and placement, restore normal geometry after fullscreen, and avoid treating compositor mapping events as user changes.
Hide both native and Discord titlebars on floating PiP windows, keep minimum-size changes in sync, and restore popout lifecycle behavior when closing or navigating.
Open ordinary web links in the system browser without replacing the Discord page, including links that navigate in the same window.
Resolve Discord protocol ownership from the actual desktop command and register the selected application or development profile reliably, including paths requiring desktop-entry escaping.
Recover interrupted source patch application on CI runners without a global Git identity and make capture descriptor-cleanup tests reliable when run in parallel.
Port the complete native binary patch chain to Canary 1.0.2483 and accept its sixth popout spellcheck callback argument.
Update the Electron alpha.10 audio/video dependency patch context while preserving the existing integration.
Port the FFmpeg build changes to Electron alpha.10 while preserving upstream aligned frame sizes, plane layouts and Media Foundation buffer lifetimes.
Improvements: Make downloading development runtime artifacts an explicit option.

Fixes: Complete the remaining Chromium dependency patch ports and source preflight for Electron alpha.10.

Improvements: Detect updates from both Discord's Electron fork and upstream Electron, including fork changes when the upstream version has not changed.
Allow a one-off Electron workflow run on the self-hosted PC while keeping budgeted Blacksmith builds as the default.
Automatically merge main into dev after main changes, preserving development commits and reporting merge conflicts for a maintainer to resolve.
Advance the tracked upstream Electron source to 46.0.0-alpha.10.
Package the completed, qualified Electron alpha.10 runtime from the local workflow build.
